FIELDS.NAME: ShipSmart Post & Parcel Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At ShipSmart Post & Parcel Services, we operate a full-service post office and shipping center offering a wide range of mailing and shipping solutions to both individuals and businesses. Our core operations include efficient handling of domestic and international packages through established partnerships with major carriers such as USPS, UPS, and FedEx. We provide secure packaging services, retail shipping supplies, and mailbox rentals, all while ensuring compliance with postal regulations.

Located in a low-crime, high-traffic area, our facility is equipped with state-of-the-art security systems to protect our customers and their shipments. We prioritize customer service with well-trained staff knowledgeable in shipping logistics, safety protocols, and exceptional customer support. We also maintain a robust inventory management system to ensure a consistent supply of packing materials and shipping products.

Regular staff training and clear operational protocols further enhance our service delivery, ensuring that we meet our customers' needs effectively. Additionally, we uphold a commitment to environmental compliance by avoiding the handling of prohibited or hazardous items without proper controls, further ensuring the integrity and safety of our operations. Overall, ShipSmart aims to provide a seamless shipping experience while maintaining high standards of service and safety.
